statutory.label: entailment
statutory.reasoning: The statute 31 U.S.C. § 5324 prohibits structuring transactions. The fact pattern shows six separate transfers — three cash and three wire — totalling well over $10,000 within a few weeks, indicating a pattern of breaking amounts to avoid reporting thresholds. This satisfies the statutory element of conducting multiple sub‑threshold transactions designed to evade reporting, and the language prohibits structuring transactions.
